as_read: Trials of phosphatidic acid alone address resistance training with conflicting, non-significant between-group results; the one label prints a phosphatidylserine and phosphatidic acid blend for stress hormones, and the trials of that kind of complex are combinations.

quote.text: Results of this study suggest that PA supplementation, in combination with a 3 days·week-1 resistance-training program for 8 weeks, did not have a differential effect compared with PL on changes in muscle thickness or 1RM strength.

proposed_decision_text: The one label (DSLD 82935, Stress Hormone Balancing Blend) prints Phosphatidylserine & Phosphatidic Acid 400 mg as a blend with no separate amount for phosphatidic acid, and carries a stress hormone purpose rather than a muscle purpose. Abstracts only. Two trials tested 750 mg of phosphatidic acid alone during resistance training: PMID 28177725 found no group differences in muscle thickness or 1RM strength, and PMID 23035701, a 16-man pilot, reported that parametric analysis was unable to demonstrate significant differences, with likely benefit only by magnitude based inference. Neither abstract names a primary outcome and neither concerns stress hormones. PMID 25081826 tested a soy phosphatidylserine and phosphatidic acid complex for the endocrine stress response; 400 mg PS plus 400 mg PA normalized ACTH and cortisol responses in chronically high but not low stressed men, the 200 mg plus 200 mg arm showed no significant differences, and the abstract names no primary outcome. PMID 29576358 reports a positive primary outcome (DRSP) for 400 mg PS plus 400 mg PA in premenstrual syndrome, a purpose this label does not carry. Both are two-ingredient complexes, not phosphatidic acid alone. PMID 27274715 tested MaxxTOR, which adds L-leucine, HMB and vitamin D3. No study meets the rule for this label, so no credit is proposed.
stop_list: The label gives a 400 mg PS and PA total with no split, so it can't be compared with the 400 mg plus 400 mg or 200 mg plus 200 mg trial arms
stored_rating_note: positive_moderate rests on PMID 23035701, whose parametric analysis was not significant; the same-dose null trial PMID 28177725 is not in the stored record. The record's 750 mg resistance-training context is not what this label prints.
unread_notes: Abstracts only; no full text opened. One search, count 27, query: phosphatidic acid supplementation randomized trial (cortisol OR stress OR strength OR muscle OR lean mass). The only label row carries 0 NP with the amount on the parent blend row.
